records.title: A Language‐Guided Multimodal Foundation Model for Zero‐Shot and Multi‐Task Brain Signal Analysis
records.reason: The contribution is an application foundation model for brain-signal analysis, not LLM inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: Reviser: Revision-Capable Text Generation via Autoregressive Cursor Actions
records.reason: The paper establishes competitive quality and fewer convention-counted FLOPs than multi-pass models, but at small model scales and without deployment latency/throughput measurements; synthetic edit trajectories also limit transfer to natural generation.

records.title: DRM: An Interpretable Dual-view Reasoning Model for POI Retrieval
records.reason: DRM is a dual-view reasoning model for POI retrieval. The abstract describes retrieval/task performance rather than inference-efficiency improvement.

records.title: Temporally plastic photonic processor for real-time adaptive computing
records.reason: The photonic processor concerns general real-time adaptive computing and does not identify an LLM inference/serving workload or efficiency result.

records.title: LLM-Generated Lay-Language Protocols for Molecular Tumor Board Patients: Evaluation of Quality and Clinical Usability
records.reason: This evaluates lay-language cancer protocols generated by LLMs for clinical usability; no inference-efficiency method is claimed.
